## VIZSLA SILVER ANNOUNCES RESULTS OF ANNUAL GENERAL AND SPECIAL MEETING


October 9, 2026


[View PDF](https://wp-vizslasilvercorp-2024.s3.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/media/2026/10/2025-10-09-Vizsla-Silver-2026-AGM-Results-Press-Release-FINAL.pdf)


**Vancouver, British Columbia (October 9, 2026) – Vizsla Silver Corp.** **(TSX: VZLA) (NYSE: VZLA) (Frankfurt: 0G31** ) (“ **Vizsla Silver** ” or the “ **Company** ”) is pleased to announce the results of the Company’s annual general and special meeting of shareholders (the “ **Meeting** ”) held in Vancouver, British Columbia on October 8, 2026.


Shareholders were asked to vote on the following:


- Fix the number of directors at seven persons;
- Elect Craig Parry, Michael Konnert, Simon Cmrlec, Harry Pokrandt, David Cobbold, Eduardo Luna and Suki Gill as directors for the ensuing year;
- Appoint Deloitte LLP as the Company’s auditor for the ensuing year and authorize the directors to determine the remuneration to be paid to the auditor; and
- Approve the continuation, amendment and restatement of the Shareholder Rights Plan.


Shareholders approved all motions put forth at the Meeting and a total of 188,580,782 shares were voted, representing 53.11% of the Company’s issued and outstanding shares as at the record date for the Meeting. A detailed report of the results is available on the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ and EDGAR. Please refer to Table 1 below for the detailed results of the votes for each director

**About Vizsla Silver**


Vizsla Silver (TSX: VZLA | NYSE: VZLA) is a Canadian development company advancing Panuco, its 100%-owned silver-gold project in Sinaloa, Mexico. The November 2025 Feasibility Study outlines 17.4 Moz AgEq annual production over an initial 9.4-year mine life, an after-tax NPV (5%) of US$1.8B, a 111% IRR, and a 7-month payback at US$35.50/oz silver and US$3,100/oz gold. Vizsla Silver is targeting H2 2028 for first silver production.


For more information, please contactinfo@vizslasilver.ca , visit our website at[www.vizslasilvercorp.ca](http://www.vizslasilvercorp.ca/) or call (604) 364-2215.


ON BEHALF OF THE COMPANY


Michael Konnert,
*President and Chief Executive Officer*
